qualification: physical device measurement; single run; not a release gate
device: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, CUDA, one device; drives: PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD for the original HDF5 (direct-read ceiling 5.5 GB/s measured separately), a second NVMe SSD for the saved form

provenance.loader: quantem.gpu.io.PairedLoader defaults (6 readers, 10 x 128 MiB pinned slots, 3 x 8192-scan rolling buffers)

input.source: complete bitshuffle+LZ4 HDF5 masters, 27 shards each

protocol: io.load-equivalent PairedLoader.load_many over the acquisition list with a memory-budget admit callback; the first three to sixty-six acquisitions were admitted, the sixty-seventh was refused for memory

rows.measurement: series load, original bitshuffle+LZ4 HDF5 to paired resident
rows.boundary: first shard read submitted to last source resident (consumer stream synchronized)
rows.cache_state: shards read with direct I/O (page cache bypassed); master metadata pages may be warm
rows.admission: 1.31 GiB per source plus 1 GiB margin against free device memory plus cached pool bytes

rows.measurement: per-acquisition resident-ready wall inside the pipeline
rows.boundary: first shard read submitted to source resident
device encode kernels, consumer stream synchronized
device index kernels, consumer stream synchronized

rows.memory_kind: sum of resident arrays (payload, offsets, models, index)

rows.measurement: device bytes in use after load
rows.memory_kind: cudaMemGetInfo total minus free (includes pool cache and loader staging)

rows.measurement: first virtual image, all sources, bright-field mask
rows.parity: first source digest equal to the frozen independent raw-count reduction

rows.measurement: save one source as the paired resident form
rows.boundary: write plus fsync to the root drive

rows.measurement: reopen one saved form through io.load
rows.boundary: header read to resident, byte-identical to the streamed source
rows.cache_state: file written seconds earlier; root drive

rows.measurement: series load, original HDF5 to paired resident, chunk tables parsed from the staged image (revision 91d6f5b6)
rows.boundary: first shard read submitted to last source resident
rows.cache_state: shards read with direct I/O; no metadata reads during streaming
rows.note: 0.437 s per acquisition against a 0.40 s direct-read floor for 2.19 GB per acquisition at 5.5 GB/s
